## v18 pre-opening re-verification (C6): **mostly HOLDS**. One listed object is wrong; four small refinements

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T14:38Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read-only re-verification on objectstack `main` `6befe19c6e`. The cut base was 2026-09-04, 3,298 commits earlier. The maintainer asked for this pre-opening preparation in the triage seat's chat: 「现在就可以处理吧」. Classes, positions and functions only. **The claiming seat applies these corrections before building. The body is not rewritten.**

**Holds:**
- All eight listed objects still carry the injected organization column:
  - `sys_job`, `sys_job_run`, `sys_job_queue`;
  - `sys_flow_dispatch`;
  - `sys_migration`, `sys_migration_journal`;
  - `sys_secret`;
  - `sys_presence`.
- No PR since the cut touched their tenancy.
- Six of them have only system-context writers. `sys_presence` has no ObjectQL writer at all.
- `sys_setting`'s global rung (`settings-service.ts:1383`, `:2318-2336`, `:2436`) holds.
- §6 Q3 was accepted.
- #12699 holds. #13433 was absorbed: it closed as a duplicate on 09-27.

**Corrections:**
- **`sys_secret` is tenant-attributed today, so take it off this card's list.** The object secret-field producer writes it with the business write's driver options (`objectql/src/engine.ts:8838-8851`). `SqlDriver.injectTenantOnInsert` then stamps `organization_id` (`driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts:15551-15562`), and the organization is bound into the encryption AAD (`engine.ts:8826`). Its fate belongs in C7's inventory (#15211).
- **The one-sentence summary contradicts the scope:** `sys_http_delivery` is excluded, and the notification inbox is deferred to C7. The claim states the scope as listed.
- **Name the existing attribution field:** `sys_audit_log.tenant_id` (`sys-audit-log.object.ts:350,380`), already written by four writers.
- **One new deployment-level audit writer:** #19194's `platform-admin-standing-audit.ts:197-238`, which writes an owner-less row and cites D7.

**Day one:** dispatchable once #15193 closes, with the corrections above.

## Triage: unlocked, `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. The v18 line is open: #15193 was closed on the maintainer's word. C6, dispatchable first

Blocked-by: none

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T12:36Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**The blocker is released:**
- #15193 closed `completed` in this act (`6037915987`), on the maintainer's words in the triage seat's chat: 「我建议直接启动 v18 开发吧」, 「你应该先解锁 v18 所有的卡片」, 「同意」.
- The ruling record is #22050 `6037890422` (B: v18 develops on `main`, with no last 17.x).
- This card's `Blocked-by:` named #15193 alone.

**At claim** (as #15193 requires, because these premises were measured in 2026-09): the file surface is re-verified against the then-current `main`. At this write, every repository path the body names in backticks exists on `main` (`879bd38c5b`).

- **Order:** C10 (cloud#1979) waits on this card, per its `Blocked-by:` line.

**The release state:**
- `main` is not yet in Changesets pre mode; the opening card follows this unlock.
- A breaking change landing before the opening is graded `minor` with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition, under the launch-window convention. Once pre mode is in, `major` is open.
- ⛔ #21988 is not merged.

Claim: PM loop round 9 (this card, C6 of ADR-0131, unlocked by triage `6038050559` at the v18 opening; triage's re-verification `6018668592` binds the corrections) · 2026-10-07T12:44Z
Session: `session_01GV6oYwgc1kWiUCb1YaprQ7`
Account: `os-warren` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-15207-deployment-level-no-org-column`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-15207`
Domain: `domain:spec` (the card also carries `domain:services`; this seat holds it whole)
Seat: `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549)
File surface (at `origin/main` `e67ba80049`; stop on breach and explain in the report). It is the card's four scope items, with the corrections in `6018668592` applied.
- **(1) `systemFields.tenant: false`** on the objects no writer attributes to an organization, each confirmed by a writer census with a firing control:
  - `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-job.object.ts`, `sys-job-run.object.ts`, `sys-job-queue.object.ts`;
  - `packages/services/service-automation/src/sys-flow-dispatch.object.ts`;
  - `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-migration.object.ts`, `sys-migration-journal.object.ts`;
  - `packages/services/service-realtime/src/objects/sys-presence.object.ts`.
  - ⛔ Not `sys_secret` (tenant-attributed today; its fate is C7's, #15211). ⛔ Not `sys_http_delivery`, ⛔ not `sys_email`. The `sys_inbox_message` / `sys_notification*` / `sys_user_preference` family is recorded for C7, not changed.
  - One ADR-0087 entry per removed column, in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (`MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS`) or wherever the playbook places a column removal.
- **(2) `sys_audit_log`** (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts`): no injected organization column. The organization a row is about stays in the existing attribution field `tenant_id`, which the tenant-field resolver does not claim. RLS readers of the audit page filter on it explicitly. The deployment-level writer `platform-admin-standing-audit.ts` (#19194) is pinned.
- **(3) `sys_setting` `scope: 'global'`** rows leave the tenant-scoped object, per §6 Q3: configuration or a tenant-less `sys_platform_setting`. `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts`'s user → tenant → deployment cascade reads the new source.
- **(4) #12699:** `platformGlobalObjects` becomes an input to `resolveInjectedSystemColumns` (`packages/metadata-core/src/injected-system-columns.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts`) on the declaring deployment. No column is injected, and the stand-down semantics retire.
- The tests of each package touched, whatever `packages/spec` generators move, and `.changeset/15207-*.md`. The grade follows triage's release-state note in `6038050559`: `minor` with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 dispositions before Changesets pre mode is in, `major` once it is.
- **Declared cross-lane files:** `domain:engine` (`packages/platform-objects`, `packages/metadata-core`) and `domain:services` (`service-automation`, `service-realtime`, `service-settings`, `plugin-audit`). The declarations go on #6367 and #21118.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`. This session lives across the run and the build stays in this container. `--tier`: no path-derived mandate. An at-tier contract review is owed before it enqueues (`packages/spec/src/**`, security), from an isolated subagent.
Clause-②: no (narrowing: deployment-level objects lose their injected organization column and the global settings rung moves; whether any `@objectstack/spec` export widens is measured on the built declaration closure by the dev, and the measurement decides)
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: 6038050559
Serial constraints cleared:
- None of the open PRs touches the listed object files, `injected-system-columns.ts`, `settings-service.ts` or `conversions/registry.ts` (scan at this stamp), and no live `Claim:` names them.
- This seat's #13458, claimed in the same round, also inserts into `conversions/registry.ts` (sorted, gap-disjoint).
- C10 (cloud#1979) waits on this card.

Claim revision (file surface and two decisions) · `domain:spec` seat 2 · `session_01GV6oYwgc1kWiUCb1YaprQ7` · 2026-10-07T17:46Z · amends claim `6038184526`, on the dev report `6042515710` (PR #22107, `Part of #15207`). ⛔ Not a new claim.

**This claim's landing is narrowed to scope item (1).** PR #22107 lands item (1) alone, as `Part of #15207`. Items (2), (3) and (4) are not built under this claim: when PR #22107 merges, the card is released to `pm:queue` with the report's questions for them recorded (below). The seat is draining on the maintainer's order and takes no new round on this card.

**Decision 1 (report question 1): A, the file joins the surface.**
- **Added:** `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts`, `tenantWindowsFor` only (`domain:engine`). An object with no tenant column answers no tenant windows, the shape the federated case (#21918) already has. Also one pin with a column-less object and a tenant-scope retention override.
- **Why it rides PR #22107:** item (1) causes the regression. The dev measured that on a new database, a tenant-scope `lifecycle.retention_overrides` entry naming `sys_job_run`, `sys_job_queue` or `sys_flow_dispatch` makes both reaper passes throw `INVALID_FILTER`, so that table's retention stops. B (landing without it) would ship a known regression. No open PR touches the file at this stamp. The declaration goes on #6367.
- ⛔ Whether to refuse such an override at save is not decided here (the report's out-of-scope finding). It stays a note.

**Decision 2 (report question 2): A, the object-level capability gate stays.**
- The seven objects declare `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`. ADR-0131 D7 says objects without the column "are governed by object permission, not by the wall", and the dev's measured H5 table shows the column gone with no gate admits a walled deployment's `organization_admin` to every organization's rows.
